title: Highly recommended
text: Highly recommended. Not only does this look nice, it also was a great deal at $13.79. It’s also quite sturdy. I keep 2 in my refrigerator. One for lemonade and one flor iced tea.

product_metadata.title: Red Co. Clear Glass 61.75 Oz Beverage Serving Pitcher with Red Lid and Handle
features: This functional pitcher can be used for any liquids such as iced tea and fruit-infused juices, sangria, or drink mixes for the kids
Ideal for use at home or even outdoors for serving your guests refreshing drinks during warm-weather gatherings on the patio
Features a spill-resistant pouring spout, a wide mouth for easy refills, a convenient, comfortable handle, and a tight lid to keep your beverages free of dust, insects, and dirt
Made of thick and durable glass with BPA-free plastic lid, the pitcher is dishwasher safe
Dimensions: 6” Dia (7” with handle) x 9.5”H; Capacity: 61.75 fluid ounces (1.9 quarts or 1.8 liters)
description: Simple, elegant, and functional, this glass pitcher offers a stylish way to serve any refreshments of choice. With its solid design, it is especially well-suited for outdoor barbecues, picnics, poolside parties, family reunions, and everyday use. It can also be used as a carafe for ice-cold lemonades, milkshakes, or smoothies, which makes it great for the dining table. It’s a functional object that can easily double as décor while helping you stay healthy and hydrated at home.
